description: Land Acquisition - Akarahediya & Minirandetiya D/S Division, Laggafe - Pallegama, Mathale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act for the Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their locations, extents, claimants, and possessors. The content falls squarely under land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions for public purposes, which aligns with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification.
